procedural_matters: The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
Before the hearing started, GRE 221447 took a Post-Race Penalty.
GRE 221447 did not attend the hearing; the hearing proceeded under rule 63.1(b).
Two minutes after starting the hearing, the panel adjourned the hearing, to be reconvened later.
The panel reconvened the hearing 45 minutes later. At that point, GRE 221447 was present.
facts: The wind was blowing 14 knots with 50 cm waves and chop.
NED was sailing upwind on leg 4 approaching the zone of mark 2, close-hauled on starboard tack.
GRE was clear ahead of NED, sailing close-hauled on starboard tack, one boat length ahead of NED and one boat length to leeward.
At four boat lengths from mark 2, GRE tacked from starboard to port.
NED bore away, passing within 15 centimeters of the rudder of GRE.
Boats from the Men’s Blue fleet were sailing on the reach between marks 1 and 2 and were also approaching and rounding mark 2.
The leading boat of the Men’s Yellow fleet rounded mark 2 first, followed closely by boats from the Men’s Blue fleet.
After leaving the zone of mark 2, GRE gybed and tacked two times.
conclusions: NED had a reasonable apprehension of collision with GRE. GRE broke rule 10.
GRE took a Two-Turns Penalty after getting well clear of other boats as soon as reasonably possible.
GRE took an applicable penalty, and shall not be penalized further according to rule 60.5(c)(2).
decision: GRE is not penalized further as a result of the hearing.
